notes: guiWin: 1116 methods at the base. 1098 move into 42 mixins (C10); the 18 unlisted ones stay in the host on purpose: __init__ and the 16 other names in dir(QMainWindow) (setWindowIcon, setWindowTitle, setDisabled, dragEnterEvent, dropEvent, changeEvent, leaveEvent, enterEvent, mousePressEvent, eventFilter, keyPressEvent, keyReleaseEvent, closeEvent, showEvent, show, resizeEvent) plus super_show (zero-arg super()). The class body statements (docstring, sigClosed, sigExportFrame, KEY_EVENT_KEYS and its .update call) stay in the host too.

Bases: QMainWindow, the 42 new mixins, then WhitelistGUIElements, CombineGuiElements, CombineGUIWorker and the gui/mixins classes in their base-commit order (synthesis rule 9, R7). Every moved method is unique among the new mixins, none is a QMainWindow attribute (PyQt6 and PyQt5 checked), so every name resolves to the same function as before. The 6 guiWin methods that override shared mixins (setAllIDs, countObjectsTimelapse, countObjectsSnapshots, countObjects, updateObjectCounts in FrameDataGuiElements; customAnnotationDialogKwargs in KeyboardGuiElements) still win because all main_window mixins precede the shared ones.

_font fixup (C10, not a mapping item): resizeSlidersArea drops `global _font` and writes gui_main_constants._font; every reader (gui_createBottomWidgets, gui_createImg1BottomWidgets, saveData, guiWin.show) reads gui_main_constants._font, never a from-import.

gui.py top-level items that stay in gui/main_window/window.py (unlisted): pg.setConfigOption, the PerformanceWarning simplefilter, np.seterr and the Windows AppUserModelID if-block. shortcut_filepath is not listed: C1 moves it to cellacdc/__init__.py and gui.py and gui_viewer_tools.py then import it, so it is no item at C4/C10 (ShortcutsGuiElements in window_core.py reads it from cellacdc).

The comment block before GREEN_HEX ("# important functions" ...) and the "# Hard-coded shortcuts ..." comment before _font travel with them to constants.py as leading comments; the comment lines after RP_OPT_PERC_CUTOUT_MAX are part of its statement block.

C4 relies on the moves shard (C3): gui_viewer_tools.py -> gui/mixins/viewer_tools.py, gui_core.py -> gui/mixins/window_core.py and gui_combine.py -> gui/main_window/image_processing.py as whole git mv moves; gui_viewer_tools.py, gui_core.py, gui_combine.py and gui_utils.py are split shims. Only the items leaving those files are listed here. gui_core.GUICoreElements and _logger stay in window_core.py; gui_combine.py keeps both classes in image_processing.py.

Aliases: gui/main_window/<module>.py -> gui_main_<module> (window.py itself is gui_window, from the moves shard); gui/mixins modules use gui_<module> like the whole-moved mixins (gui_navigation, gui_annotations, gui_custom_annotations, gui_overlay), so the expected aliases of the C3 moves are gui_viewer_tools for viewer_tools.py and gui_window_core for window_core.py (listed here because it receives items in C4). window.py imports the mixin classes by name.

Proposed module docstrings for C14 (modules that git mv creates without one): gui/mixins/window_core.py: "Core window services shared by the main GUI and the measurements viewer: settings CSV get/set, window geometry and get2DRP (GUICoreElements), worker progress, keyboard shortcuts (shortcuts.ini), restore of the default settings." gui/main_window/image_processing.py: "Image processing of the displayed channels in the main GUI: preprocessing recipes (PreprocessingGuiElements) and combine channels (CombineGuiElements, CombineGUIWorker). Mixins of guiWin only." gui/mixins/viewer_tools.py keeps the gui_viewer_tools.py docstring, which still lists the classes that leave in C4: shorten it to zoom, ruler, scale bar and timestamp, color scheme, labels colormap, image properties, bottom layout, slideshow and 3D viewer.

myutils.getCustomAnnotTooltip -> gui/mixins/custom_annotations.py and myutils.get_number_fstring_formatter -> gui/mixins/overlay.py (C8, single users per the myutils design) are listed here as the task asked; the myutils shard owns cellacdc/myutils.py and should map them identically (de-duplicate when merging). get_number_fstring_formatter is also read by HoverInfoGuiElements (object_info.py), which then imports gui_overlay.

Compat for C4 (moves shard / compat tables): whitelist.py stays a real module but needs a lazy deprecated WhitelistGUIElements name (module __getattr__, no __deprecated_shim__ marker); gui_utils.py becomes a split shim forwarding nearest_ID_to_centroid to whitelist.py. whitelist.py then drops its GUI imports (apps, widgets, html_utils, exception_handler, disableWindow, gui_utils): they move with WhitelistGUIElements to whitelist_ids.py.

In-function relative imports of moved code (11 in gui.py, 2 in gui_viewer_tools ShortcutsGuiElements, 7 in WhitelistGUIElements) must be recomputed to absolute imports by the tool; nearest_ID_to_centroid call site in Whitelist becomes a direct call once it lives in whitelist.py.
